notes: Fresh isolated repositories. Breakdown only; no implementation. Bracket cases must use the linked manifest directly and plain cases must author the same schema before one batch create.

evals.name: bracket-manifest-batch-and-rehome
evals.prompt: In the isolated repo, seed a bracketed epic with an approved concise plan, valid linked manifest, and one recorded external dependency re-home. Use jit-breakdown to instantiate it.
evals.expected_output: One batch creates the exact issues and intra-edges; returned keys wire sources to B, sinks to C, and the external dependency to its target. Stored issues omit planning, graph verification passes, and both breakdown gates pass.

evals.name: plain-breakdown-same-manifest
evals.prompt: Create a non-breakable story with a linked specification, then use jit-breakdown. Do not implement its work.
evals.expected_output: Plain analysis writes the canonical bare manifest with semantic keys and worker-sized terminals, validates/dry-runs it, creates one batch, wires configured containment, and verifies exact fidelity.

evals.name: markdown-only-hard-cutover
evals.prompt: Seed a bracketed epic whose P has an approved linked Markdown plan but no breakdown JSON, then invoke jit-breakdown.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops before mutation with an actionable missing-manifest error. It does not reinterpret Markdown, synthesize a backfill, create issues, or alter edges.
